description: Create a new collection (custom data TABLE). It starts with the system columns (id/inserted_at/updated_at/creator_id); pass `columns` to add custom fields. NOTE: to WRITE records into it, use an HTTP function (webcake-data: db.model(table).create({...})) — the dashboard has no direct record-insert API. See get_http_function for the SDK guide.

date_default_type.description: For type 'date'/'naive_datetime' only: how the default date is set.

note.description: Help text / description for the column.

reference.description: For type 'reference' only: the referenced table_name, or a system entity (customer | product | article | blog | variation).

reference_type.description: For type 'reference' only: 'system' (built-in entity) or 'collection' (another custom table).

type.description: text | rich_text | url | integer | float | decimal | boolean | reference | color | image | media_gallery | video | audio | document | date | naive_datetime | time | address | object | array

table_name.description: Table name (snake_case, unique). Defaults to name.

name: create_collection
